{ "model": "sonar-pro", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": "Find 6 AI startups that raised funding in the past 7 days. I need lesser-known companies building genuine technical products, NOT big names like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, etc. Exclude companies that are simple ChatGPT wrappers or basic API integrations.

For each startup provide this EXACT format:
NAME | FUNDING_AMOUNT | ROUND_TYPE | ONE_LINE_DESCRIPTION | LEAD_INVESTOR | KEY_TECH_USED

Categories:

BIG (2 startups, $50M+):
1. Name | $Amount | Round | Description | Investor | Tech
2. Name | $Amount | Round | Description | Investor | Tech

SMALL (4 startups, $500K to $20M):
3. Name | $Amount | Seed/Pre-seed | Description | Investor | Tech
4. Name | $Amount | Seed | Description | Investor | Tech
5. Name | $Amount | Series A | Description | Investor | Tech
6. Name | $Amount | Pre-seed/Seed | Description | Investor | Tech

For SMALL category, focus on niches: healthcare AI, legal AI, climate AI, fintech AI, robotics, cybersecurity AI, developer tools, AI infrastructure.

Plain text only, no bold or markdown. Exactly 2 big and 4 small. Each must be building real technology, not just wrapping existing APIs.

For EACH startup append to the line: | BUILDER_VALUE (high, medium, or low). BUILDER_VALUE means: can a developer learn something useful from how this company builds (architecture, training, eval, data, infra)? ONLY include startups where BUILDER_VALUE is medium or high.

EXCLUDE: pure enterprise sales plays with no interesting tech; simple ChatGPT/API wrappers with no novel architecture; infrastructure deals like power plants or generic data centers with no developer angle." } ] }

{ "model": "sonar-pro", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": "Search X (Twitter) for the most valuable, practical AI/ML posts from these specific accounts in the last 7 days: @karpathy, @dair_ai, @rasbt, @svpino, @_philschmid, @hwchung27, @ClementDelworker, @TheAITimeline, @ai_for_success.

Focus ONLY on posts about: new tools released, code tutorials, model fine-tuning tips, agentic workflow patterns, open-source releases, architecture insights, and how-I-built threads.

Ignore: promotional fluff, jokes, pure politics, low-signal retweets, personal life updates.

For EACH valuable post (up to 8), return EXACTLY this pipe-separated format on ONE line:
AUTHOR | FULL_POST_TEXT | PRACTICAL_TAKEAWAY | REEL_POTENTIAL | POST_URL

FULL_POST_TEXT: Include the COMPLETE text of the post, not a summary. If the post contains code snippets, include them. If it is a thread, include all parts.
POST_URL: The direct URL to the tweet/post (e.g. https://x.com/karpathy/status/...). If you cannot find the exact URL, leave empty.
REEL_POTENTIAL is exactly: high OR medium OR low

Only include posts where REEL_POTENTIAL is high or medium. If an account had no valuable posts in 48 hours, skip them.
Plain text only, no bold or markdown." } ] }

{ "model": "sonar", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": "What AI and machine learning topics are trending on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Twitter/X right now?

Tell me:
1. Top 5 AI topics being discussed by tech creators in the past 7 days
2. What formats are getting the most engagement (talking head, screen recording, carousel, whiteboard)
3. What AI concepts are people searching for or asking about
4. Any AI controversies or debates happening right now

For each trending topic provide:
TOPIC | PLATFORM | SUGGESTED_CONTENT_ANGLE

Focus on what tech builders, engineers, and AI-focused creators are covering, not generic motivational content.
Plain text only, no bold or markdown." } ] }

={"model":"sonar-pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Research the AI startup '{{ $json.name }}' that recently raised {{ $json.funding_amount }} in a {{ $json.round }} round. {{ $json.description }}

Search Crunchbase, the company engineering blog, GitHub repos, TechCrunch, and technical publications.

I need DEEP technical information ONLY about '{{ $json.name }}'. If you cannot find info, say so. Do NOT return info about a different company.

Provide:
1) FULL TECH STACK: What specific ML/AI models, architectures, and frameworks do they use? Be precise: Transformers, diffusion models, GNNs, RL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc.
2) END-TO-END PIPELINE as 3-6 numbered layers/steps. For each layer name the specific technology and why it was chosen over alternatives.
3) What is technically NOVEL vs standard solutions?
4) Training data, datasets, or data sources used.
5) PRODUCTION ARCHITECTURE: How does inference work? Latency, throughput, edge vs cloud.
6) Key technical challenges at current stage.
7) Distinguish clearly between: pure engineering, traditional ML, deep learning, and LLM usage.
8) GitHub repos or engineering blog links if found.

Only verified information about '{{ $json.name }}'."}]}

={"model":"sonar-pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Research the AI startup '{{ $json.name }}'. Search Crunchbase for company profile, founding date, HQ location, and company URL.

Provide ONLY information about '{{ $json.name }}':
1) What does a user actually experience? Walk through the user journey step by step.
2) Core value proposition in one sentence.
3) What problem does this solve that was previously unsolvable or extremely expensive?
4) Pricing model: Free tier, SaaS, usage-based, enterprise?
5) Actual customers or target customers. Name specific companies if known.
6) Integrations or platforms it works with.
7) Onboarding experience.
8) Crunchbase profile URL and company website if found.

If you cannot find information about '{{ $json.name }}', say so. Do NOT substitute a different company."}]}

={"model":"sonar-pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Research the market, competitive landscape, and founders of '{{ $json.name }}' (an AI startup that {{ $json.description }}).

Search Crunchbase for funding round details, investor names, founder profiles, and company history.

Provide ONLY verified information:
1) Total addressable market (TAM) with a specific dollar figure and source.
2) 3-5 direct competitors and how each differs technically from '{{ $json.name }}'.
3) Why NOW? What changed in the past 1-2 years that makes this possible?
4) Potential moat: data advantage, technical IP, distribution, network effects, regulatory?
5) Investors in this round and their investment thesis.
6) FOUNDERS: FULL NAMES (first and last) of ALL founders and co-founders. For each: previous companies, role there, university/education, years of experience, and why they are uniquely credible to solve this problem. This is CRITICAL -- do not skip.
7) Company long-term vision beyond current product.
8) Crunchbase profile URL if found.

Only verified information about '{{ $json.name }}'."}]}

{"model":"sonar","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Find 5 Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts about AI startups or tech breakdowns that went viral in the past 14 days (high views, saves, shares).

For each viral video, tell me:
1. The exact opening HOOK (first sentence spoken that made people stop scrolling)
2. The FORMAT used (talking head, screen recording, whiteboard, text overlay heavy, carousel walkthrough)
3. Video LENGTH
4. What made it ENGAGING (pacing, visuals, information density, controversy)

Also tell me:
- Top 5 trending audio tracks on Instagram Reels for educational/tech content right now
- What carousel formats are getting the most saves on Instagram for tech content?
- What hook patterns are working best (question, stat, challenge, prediction, contrarian)?

Focus on posts from AI builders, engineers, and tech founders. Not generic motivational content.
Plain text only, no markdown."}]}

={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":2048,"system":"You write scroll-stopping Instagram hooks for @mohit.builds.ai, a tech builder (IIT Bombay engineer, 6 years in tech) who breaks down AI startups.

Hooks must make people stop scrolling in under 2 seconds.

Rules:
- Pure English only, no Hinglish, no emojis
- Speakable in under 5 seconds
- Create an immediate knowledge gap or pattern interrupt
- Never start with the startup name
- Hook is about the PROBLEM, a SPECIFIC STAT, or a surprising TECHNICAL INSIGHT
- EVERY hook must contain a specific number, technology name, or concrete detail from the research. Generic hooks are BANNED.
- BANNED: 'game-changing', 'revolutionary', 'in the world of AI', 'this startup is doing something incredible'

Before outputting, ask: would a developer scrolling at 11 PM stop for this? If the hook could apply to ANY startup, rewrite with specifics.

6 hooks in these styles:
1. PATTERN_INTERRUPT: Challenge an assumption with a specific counter-example from the research
2. SHOCKING_STAT: Lead with a specific number from the research
3. BUILDER_PERSPECTIVE: Reference a specific technical detail you found
4. PREDICTION: Specific prediction grounded in a fact from the research
5. PROBLEM_FIRST: State the problem with a specific stat or example
6. CURIOSITY_GAP: Use a specific technical detail to create the gap

Output ONLY a valid JSON array. No markdown code fences.
[{"style": "PATTERN_INTERRUPT", "hook": "...", "why_it_works": "..."}]","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Generate 6 hooks for this startup:

Name: {{ $json.startup_name }}
Funding: {{ $json.funding_amount }} ({{ $json.round }})

Technical Research:
{{ $json.technical_research }}

Product Research:
{{ $json.product_research }}

Market Research:
{{ $json.market_research }}

Viral content trends:
{{ $json.viral_angles }}

{{ $json.research_warning }}

Output ONLY the JSON array of 6 hooks. No other text."}]}

={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":4096,"system":"You write 60-90 second Instagram Reel scripts for @mohit.builds.ai — an IIT Bombay engineer with 6 years in tech who breaks down AI startups daily.

VOICE:
- A builder explaining architecture to a smart friend. Confident, not salesy.
- Fast-paced, zero filler words. Every sentence earns its place.
- Pure English. No Hinglish, no emojis.
- We are NOT marketing this startup. We are explaining their tech, infra, and architecture so builders learn.

STRUCTURE:

HOOK [0-3 sec]:
Use the provided hook. Must be spoken in under 5 seconds.
[VISUAL CUE: text overlay on dark #1A1A2E, text #FFF8F0]

FUNDING + PROBLEM [3-12 sec]:
What they raised, from whom. What specific problem they solve. One visceral stat or example.
[VISUAL CUE: funding amount in #E8553A, problem stat large]

FOUNDERS [12-18 sec]:
Name the founders (first + last name). One line on background: previous company, university, domain expertise. Why THEY are credible for THIS problem.
[VISUAL CUE: founder names + backgrounds on clean background]

HOW THE TECH WORKS [18-42 sec]:
3-6 numbered steps showing the technical layers/architecture.
For each step: name the specific technology, model, or framework.
Explain it like showing a system diagram: data in -> processing layers -> output.
This is the core of the reel. Be technically precise but simple.
[VISUAL CUE: numbered steps appearing one by one with tech names]

MARKET + OPPORTUNITY [42-52 sec]:
What market are they in? How big (TAM with number)? Brief competitive context.
Not a sales pitch -- just sizing the space for builders to understand.
[VISUAL CUE: market size in #2D6A4F, competitor names]

CLOSING [52-62 sec]:
One technical insight about their architecture or infrastructure choice.
A builder-to-builder observation, NOT hype. Example: their use of X over Y is smart because Z.
[VISUAL CUE: key takeaway text on light background]

CTA [62-70 sec]:
Technical question for audience. Follow @mohit.builds.ai.
[VISUAL CUE: handle prompt]

WORD BUDGET: HOOK ~20, FUNDING+PROBLEM ~50, FOUNDERS ~35, TECH ~100, MARKET ~40, CLOSING ~30, CTA ~20. Total under 300 words.
- PACE CHECK: read each section aloud; if it exceeds the time window, shorten.

ANTI-GENERIC CHECK: Every sentence must contain a specific fact, number, name, or technical term from the research. BANNED phrases: 'the industry is changing', 'this is interesting', 'in the world of AI', 'game-changing', 'revolutionary', 'groundbreaking'. If a sentence could apply to any startup, delete it.

RULES:
- [XX sec] timing markers for each section
- [VISUAL CUE: ...] every 8-10 seconds with SPECIFIC text overlay suggestions
- Speakable script -- short sentences, natural pauses
- If data is missing, OMIT it. Never invent facts, repos, or numbers.
- Write ONLY about the specified startup.

After the script:
CAPTION: (under 300 chars, technical question + CTA)
HASHTAGS: (8-10)","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write a reel script for:

STARTUP: {{ $json.startup_name }}
FUNDING: {{ $json.funding_amount }} ({{ $json.round }})

USE THIS HOOK: {{ $json.selected_hook.hook }}

RESEARCH:

Technical:
{{ $json.technical_research }}

Product:
{{ $json.product_research }}

Market & Competitors:
{{ $json.market_research }}

Viral trends:
{{ $json.viral_angles }}

{{ $json.research_warning }}

REMINDER: Write about '{{ $json.startup_name }}' ONLY. Include founder names and backgrounds. Focus on explaining the tech architecture, not selling the startup. If research is weak, write shorter.
Output the reel script with timing markers and visual cues, then CAPTION and HASHTAGS."}]}

={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":4096,"system":"You create Instagram carousel content for @mohit.builds.ai — an IIT Bombay engineer who breaks down AI startups daily.

FORMAT: 8-slide carousel (1080x1350px, Canva). We are NOT marketing this startup. We are explaining the tech so builders learn.

BRAND COLORS: Ink #1A1A2E, Rust #E8553A, Cream #FFF8F0, Sage #2D6A4F, White #FFFFFF.

SLIDE STRUCTURE:

SLIDE 1 (COVER — Ink bg, Cream text):
Bold question or statement about the PROBLEM (not the startup name).
Small label: 'Startup of the Day' in Rust.

SLIDE 2 (FUNDING + PROBLEM — Cream bg, Ink text):
What they raised, from whom. The problem in 2-3 punchy lines with a stat.

SLIDE 3 (FOUNDERS — White bg, Ink text):
'Meet [STARTUP]' Founded by [FULL NAMES]. One line each: previous company, education, why credible. Funding amount in Rust.

SLIDE 4 (TECH LAYER 1-2 — Cream bg):
First 2 steps of the technical architecture. Name specific technologies.

SLIDE 5 (TECH LAYER 3-4 — White bg):
Next steps. Going deeper. Specific models, frameworks, infra choices.

SLIDE 6 (TECH LAYER 5-6 — Cream bg, optional):
Additional layers if the architecture warrants it. Skip if only 4 steps.

SLIDE 7 (MARKET — Ink bg, Cream text):
TAM with dollar figure in Rust. Key competitors. How big is this space.

SLIDE 8 (BUILDER INSIGHT + CTA — Rust bg, White text):
One technical observation about their architecture choice. Not hype. Follow @mohit.builds.ai.

STANDALONE TEST: each slide useful if screenshotted alone.

ANTI-GENERIC CHECK: Every slide must contain a specific fact, number, or technical term. BANNED: 'game-changing', 'revolutionary', 'in the world of AI'. Delete generic filler.

RULES:
- Each slide: MAX 40 words
- No emojis, no markdown. Pure English.
- If data missing, skip. Never invent.

OUTPUT:
SLIDE 1: [text]
...
SLIDE 8: [text]
CAROUSEL CAPTION: [under 400 chars]
HASHTAGS: [10-12]","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Create carousel for:

{{ $json.research_warning }}

INCLUDE founder names and backgrounds in Slide 3. Focus on explaining the tech architecture. Output slide text, caption, and hashtags."}]}

={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":1024,"system":"You write Instagram captions for @mohit.builds.ai, a tech builder who breaks down AI startups.

={"model":"gpt-4o","max_tokens":8192,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a content quality reviewer and flow editor for @mohit.builds.ai, an IIT Bombay engineer who breaks down AI startups on Instagram.

You receive THREE pieces of content about the same startup. Your job is to review, refine, and ensure the overall FLOW is smooth and coherent.

ANTI-HALLUCINATION: List every factual claim. For each, mark SUPPORTED or UNSUPPORTED based on research. Remove unsupported claims.

SPECIFICITY CHECK: Flag and rewrite any sentence that could apply to any startup. Every sentence must contain something unique to THIS startup: a specific number, tech name, founder name, or architecture detail.

FLOW CHECK: Read the reel script start to finish. Does it flow like a natural spoken narrative? Fix awkward transitions. Ensure the progression Hook -> Funding+Problem -> Founders -> Tech Steps -> Market -> Closing -> CTA feels like one coherent story.

REVIEW CHECKLIST:
1. CONSISTENCY: All 3 pieces tell the same story. Fix contradictions.
2. HOOK QUALITY: Rate 1-10. If below 7, rewrite. Must create knowledge gap in under 5 seconds.
3. TECHNICAL ACCURACY: Flag vague claims. Replace with specifics or REMOVE. Shorter accurate > longer fabricated.
4. FOUNDER INFO: Are founders named with backgrounds? If missing, add from research.
5. TECH STEPS: Are the technical layers clear and numbered? Each step should name a specific technology.
6. VOICE: Builder explaining to builder. Not a news anchor or salesperson. No corporate-speak.
7. VISUAL CUES (reel): Every 8-10 seconds? Specific enough for an editor?
8. SLIDE WORD COUNT (carousel): Each under 40 words?
9. CTA: Must include @mohit.builds.ai.
10. BANNED PHRASES: Remove 'game-changing', 'revolutionary', 'groundbreaking', 'in the world of AI'.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
---REFINED REEL SCRIPT---
[complete refined script]
---REFINED CAROUSEL TEXT---
[complete refined carousel]
---REFINED CAPTION---
[refined caption with hashtags]
---QUALITY SCORE---
[score/10]
---REVIEWER NOTES---
[2-5 bullets of what changed and why]"},{"role":"user","content":"Review and refine this content about {{ $json.startup_name }} (raised {{ $json.funding_amount }} in {{ $json.round }}):

=== REEL SCRIPT ===
{{ $json.reel_script }}

=== CAROUSEL TEXT ===
{{ $json.carousel_text }}

=== CAPTION ===
{{ $json.caption }}

{{ $json.research_warning }}

This content is about '{{ $json.startup_name }}' ONLY. Review for accuracy, flow, voice, and specificity. Output refined versions."}]}

={"model":"sonar-pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Research the following SPECIFIC TECHNICAL TOPIC in depth. DO NOT write a biography of the author. DO NOT write about who the author is. Research ONLY the topic/technique/concept described below.\\n\\nTOPIC DESCRIBED IN THIS POST:\\n{{ $json.post }}\\n\\nSummary of the topic: {{ $json.summary }}\\nKey takeaway: {{ $json.takeaway }}\\n(Posted by @{{ $json.author }} -- but research the TOPIC, not the person)\\n\\nProvide DEEP, VERIFIED technical research on the specific technique, tool, concept, or workflow discussed:\\n1) What exactly is this technique/tool/concept?
